responsibility: Defines the cross-ABI variadic argument interface used on x86 targets that support both Microsoft and SysV calling conventions. This header belongs to the target runtime header layer rather than the backend proper: it maps __builtin_ms_va_* and __builtin_sysv_va_* operations onto the normal builtin varargs machinery on non-x86_64 targets, and publishes the corresponding ms_va_list/sysv_va_list typedefs and helper macros so front ends and system headers can name the correct ABI-specific va_list flavor.
